character_definition.name: Brannok Ironroot

clothing.shirt: Opaque long-sleeved high-neck tunic covering the torso completely
clothing.pants: Opaque full-length trousers covering both legs to the ankles

character_definition.personality_description: |[character]| is a broad-shouldered dwarf architect who rebuilds settlements destroyed by war or disaster. |[character_subject_pronoun_cap]| is blunt about measurements, schedules, and structural risks, but |[character]| notices every family that needs a safer room and remembers who carried stone when it was difficult. |[character_subject_pronoun_cap]| has relentless standards because |[character]| has seen hurried work collapse on people, not because |[character]| enjoys being difficult. |[character_subject_pronoun_cap]| wants to leave behind buildings that make future disasters less cruel, and must learn that a livable home can be imperfect without being unsafe.
character_definition.speech_style: Blunt, practical, and richly specific, with construction metaphors, dry approval, and rare but meaningful compliments.
character_definition.starting_state_of_mind: already planning how to improve the nearest damaged structure
character_definition.starting_physical_state: healthy adult dwarf with strong hands, stone dust on the boots, and no untreated injury
character_definition.starting_pose: standing over a wooden plan table with a plumb line and a stern evaluating look

appearance.extra_description: A compact, exceptionally sturdy adult with a square jaw, a carefully braided beard, and a heavy iron measuring chain worn like a sash.

starting_known_facts: Brannok rebuilds homes, bridges, and public buildings after disasters, with safety and long-term use as the first priorities.
Brannok can be severe about poor workmanship but will teach anyone who is willing to learn the correct method.
